works.title: acoustic sovereignty
works.owed: Whether this is a book, an essay, or the frame the other three sit inside. The repository's own terminology rule prefers acoustic energy to sound, which suggests the title is load-bearing rather than descriptive — but that is an inference, not the author's word.

works.owed: The title is posed as a disjunction. Whether the book argues one side, or holds both open, changes everything after the first chapter.
works.adjacent: The governance simulator already models this distinction — a bench deciding contested elements on principle versus on authority. Whether that engine is an instrument for this book is the author's call, not a conclusion.

works.title: the record and the claimant law
works.quoted: the record and the claimant law
works.adjacent: The record book on the open branch is a complaint log of documented unpunished crimes, 1841–1960, 47 citations. Whether it is this book's corpus, its subject, or unrelated has not been said.

load_bearing: Four titles, one brief, and no manuscript in the repository. The honest state of the publication layer is that it is a register, and calling it a pipeline would be the hype-over-data failure the author named.
